inlines.v: KET'TLE, noun A vessel of iron or other metal, with a wide mouth, usually without a cover, used for heating and boiling water or other liquor. Among the Tartars, a kettle represents a family, or as many as feed from one kettle Among the Dutch, a battery of mortars sunk in the earth, is called a kettle
